visual_action: A slideshow of still photos of a man, identified by on-screen text as Alex Pretti. The photos show him in various settings: hiking in the woods with a large backpack, posing in front of an American flag in medical scrubs, in a group photo with a work ID badge visible, ice climbing in a blue jacket and helmet, and standing with a bicycle in a wooded area. Each photo has a text overlay with a quote or a piece of information about him.

on_screen_text.text: “The sickening lies told about our son by the administration are reprehensible and disgusting.” —Parents of Alex Pretti, the man shot and killed by federal agents.
“I do not throw the term hero around lightly. However his last thought and act to protect a woman.”
Alex Pretti was an I.C.U. nurse at the V.A. hospital in Minnesota.
“Alex is clearly not holding a gun when attacked by Trump’s murdering and cowardly ICE thugs. [He] was trying to protect the woman ICE just pushed down all while being pepper sprayed.”
“Please get the truth out about our son. He was a good man. Thank you.”

spoken_summary: There is no speech in the video; it is accompanied only by instrumental music.
audio_music: A slow, somber, and melancholic piano-based instrumental track plays throughout the video, creating a mournful and elegiac tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow, with each photo held on screen for several seconds before fading or cutting to the next.
central_claim: Alex Pretti, a heroic nurse, was unjustly murdered by Trump's ICE agents while protecting a woman, and the government is lying about the circumstances of his death.
intended_effect: To evoke sympathy for Alex Pretti and his family, portray him as a hero, and incite anger and outrage towards Donald Trump and ICE for his killing.
